scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 30 profit. Option 1 keeps 10 useless tokens but accepts the loss. Option 2 gives up 3 useless tokens to cancel the loss. Since the tokens have no value and the profit loss is a direct hit to the firm's bottom line, the only rational choice for a manager acting in the best interests of the shareholders is to cancel the loss.

The firm is facing a loss of 30 profit. Option 1 requires giving up 3 'tokens' (which are described as having no use and being paid to no one) to cancel this loss. Option 2 results in a loss of 30 profit. Since the tokens have no intrinsic or future value to the firm or shareholders, giving them up to save 30 in profit is the only rational decision for a manager acting in the best interests of the firm.
